review:
Bullets and Bounty is a 5x5 western slot that features Quick Draw Kate and Hacksaw's DuelReels. When a VS symbol would be part of a win, it expands to cover its reel and becomes wild, and two duelists fight it out, with the winner's multiplier of 2x to 100x applied to everything on that reel.

The twist is Bounty DuelReels. Here a bounty hunter faces an outlaw, and if she wins she takes his multiplier and duels again, up to three times, adding up the values as she goes. That chain is what makes the 20,000x maximum possible. Three bonus rounds, starting with True Grit, raise the duel frequency.
